主要内容: The Hershey Company (NYSE: HSY) reported second-quarter 2021 net sales of $1,989.4 million, up 16.5% year-over-year, with organic, constant currency sales rising 15.5%. Net income reached $301.2 million, or $1.45 per share, a 12.4% increase. Adjusted earnings per share were $1.47, up 12.2%. The company raised its 2021 net sales outlook to 6–8% growth, driven by stronger recovery in away-from-home and international markets, plus the Lily's Sweets acquisition. Full-year reported EPS is now expected between $6.59 and $6.85, up 8–12% from 2020. Adjusted EPS remains at $6.79–$6.92. Increased profits from higher sales will be offset by higher tax reserves and supply chain costs. The company also expects a tax rate of 17–18%, $120–$130 million in other expenses, $130 million in interest expenses, and $550 million in capital expenditures for ERP and supply chain initiatives.
